correctness.rationale: The local criterion examines every admissible input word of length k+5; for k=2,3 the exact labeled predecessor graph over admissible length-four contexts recognizes every finite image word. Exhausting the product of its subset states with the hard-core legality counter proves onto or returns a shortest missing word. The verifier independently enumerates all finite input blocks up to each minimal obstruction. For k>=4 a one-particle separation argument proves exactly zero and five shifts, uniformly in k; no finite extrapolation is used.

value.rationale: Cofinite S-gap shifts are a canonical dynamical model of spacing constraints. The uniform exclusion-range k>=2 surjectivity-rigidity theorem distinguishes onto morphisms from numerous nononto maps, while the exact 9/6/1 onset thresholds make the finite-observation obstruction mathematically sharp. Both the all-parameter rigidity and exceptional sharp horizons are natural, non-arbitrarily selected dynamical invariants beyond a single numerical table.
